notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. No source read gives a build date, builder, staffing or fire history. The Forest Lookouts page has only the heading and county. The NHLR Tennessee list has no Kingston Springs entry, and the NPS forestry-towers form does not name Kingston Springs in its table. Two web searches gave no tower history. Elevation 827 ft is from the tnlandforms table (the record holds 252.1 m). Wikipedia is used only for the town line and population.
